Pinned @opencode/client2.0.18 provides plugin.list/check/update; no public tool domain field in generated client API. check/update are not assumed read-only or approved from their names.

Pinned plugin ToolDomain exports transform/reload/list and execute.before/after hooks; callbacks and tool execute are executable code. ConfigPlugin accepts package strings or package+arbitrary options; schema validity does not establish safe execution.
Existing shared simple draft validator handles instructions/mcp only; Skills/Agents use separate grammar helpers. No hooks/tools/plugins converter selected.

Actual pinned server plugin.list invokes Plugin.Service.list; plugin.check gathers package targets from current inventory and calls PluginUpdate.check(refresh:true). Actual PluginUpdate.check invokes Npm.check; plugin.update invokes Npm.update. Neither may be silently treated as harmless polling.

Actual plugin source distinguishes builtin/package/local/sdk with active|failed state and server/tui/rpc features. Raw failed error/ref and arbitrary package/local paths need a bounded public projection; do not leak implementation output or secrets.
Pinned Plugin.Service.list function returns current inventory without calling activation/check/update; service/context startup lifecycle still needs existing verified Native owner/preflight.

Pinned trusted plugin Context.plugin is Pick<PluginApi,list>; Context.tool exposes ToolDomain. Hooks type registers named callbacks and returns dispose; it does not expose an inventory enumeration API.

Actual Tool.Service.list returns Array.from(state.get().tools.values()) in Effect.sync; plugin host forwards ctx.tool.list directly. Tool snapshot(permission filtering) and execute are separate paths. Registry presence is not execution permission.
